description: OceanBus Console hooks — auto-start agent daemon, version check, error tracking

hooks.command: _P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; node "$_P/scripts/agent-daemon.cjs" & RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then node "$_P/scripts/health-check.cjs" track-failure "daemon start failed (exit $RC)" 2>/dev/null; else node "$_P/scripts/health-check.cjs" track-success 2>/dev/null; fi; echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":true}'

_P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; sleep 3; S=$(node "$_P/scripts/agent-daemon.cjs" status --json 2>/dev/null); echo "$S" | node -e "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); if(s.online){ console.log('OceanBus: '+s.window+' ● online | peer: '+s.peer+' | inbox: '+s.inbox); } else { console.log('OceanBus: offline — open H5 Board to pair'); }" 2>/dev/null; echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":false}'
